note: Starter open dataset of 100% funded international scholarships open to Central Asian and global applicants. Open a PR to add or verify programs for your country.

programs.name: Stipendium Hungaricum

funding.housing: Free dormitory or monthly housing allowance

core_requirements: Language certificate (typically IELTS 5.5 to 6.5 for English programs)
Sending partner nomination (in Kazakhstan: Center for International Programs / eGov)

programs.name: Global Korea Scholarship (GKS)
programs.typical_window: September to October (Undergraduate) / February to March (Graduate)
core_requirements: Apostilled academic transcripts and graduation certificate
Embassy track or University track application

programs.name: Chinese Government Scholarship (CSC)
programs.typical_window: January to April (varies by embassy and university)
core_requirements: Language proof (HSK or IELTS/TOEFL depending on track)

programs.name: Kazakhstan National State Educational Grant (ENT)
programs.typical_window: Main ENT May 10 to July 10 (2 attempts; registration in April); grant competition in July
core_requirements: Main ENT score (120 questions, 140 max points, 5 subjects)
Minimum thresholds: 50+ overall (65 to 70+ for national universities), 5+ per profile subject and History of KZ, 3+ for Reading and Math Literacy
Application via eGov or Qapps with up to 4 university/program choices
